meta.notes: Demonstrates a mobile-first travel stopover flow with long-lived citizen chatter, linked chat bubbles, and a budget follow-up branch.

steps.status: Mobility preset: mapping a calm stopover route with low transfer risk and a smooth return to Changi.

steps.snippet: Changi Jurassic Mile gives you a quick outdoors reset before you commit to a city detour.

steps.message: Start with Jurassic Mile if you want a light airport-edge stop that still feels distinct from the terminal.

steps.snippet: Katong-Joo Chiat layers murals, kopi, and Peranakan snacks into one compact east-side cluster.

steps.message: Mobility chain: airport edge -> east-side culture/food -> buffer back to Changi.

steps.snippet: The Intan area works if you want a quieter heritage pause without consuming the entire stopover.

steps.message: The hidden-gem route stays compact: Jurassic Mile, Katong-Joo Chiat, then one quieter heritage note if time still feels comfortable.

steps.snippet: Keep one leg predictable: MRT outward if possible, then leave room for a faster final return if queues or rain build up.
Use MRT for the city leg, then keep ride-hailing only as a timing safety valve for the return to Changi.

steps.status: Rebalancing for SGD300 with comfort, food value, and reliable airport return timing.

steps.snippet: Anchor spending around one food-and-heritage cluster so the stopover feels rich without stacking ticketed attractions.

steps.message: With SGD300, prioritise one compact heritage-food zone and keep transport flexible rather than ambitious.

steps.snippet: A 90-minute Changi return cushion keeps the whole trip calm on a phone-sized itinerary.
